title: Privacy Training Audit Dashboard
question:
Please help me create a privacy training audit ticket based on the data already stored in the Compliance Training Hub page.
Your automation should: 1. In the Training Assets database, find every item whose Review Due Date
   is before 2025-05-01.
2. In the Policy FAQs database, look up any FAQ entries that have the
   "Privacy" tag.
3. Create a new page inside the Compliance Requests database with exact
   title: Quarterly Privacy Training Audit - Overdue Assets Review.
4. Set Priority to High and Due to 2025-04-18. 5. In the page body, add a bullet-list block that enumerates each overdue
   training asset. Each bullet item must follow this exact text format
   (including the dashes): <Asset Name> - <Owner> - <Recommendation>.
   <Recommendation> is a brief action you suggest based on the privacy FAQ
   entries (any text is acceptable).
6. Immediately after the Audit Resources section, add a heading_3 block
   with text "Privacy Training Metrics Dashboard".
7. Under that heading, add a brown callout titled Course Statistics whose
   content is a bulleted list in this exact order: Total Lessons, Completed
   with percentage to 1 decimal, In Progress with percentage to 1 decimal,
   Beginner Level, Intermediate Level, and Advanced Level.
